readmeExcerpt:
# The Unicity Astrid OS Book

The canonical reference for Unicity Astrid OS: the kernel, the capsule model, the host ABI, the bus, and the security model.

Built with [mdBook](https://github.com/rust-lang/mdBook).

```bash
mdbook serve --open
```

The reference appendices (capability catalog, host ABI error codes, topic registry) are generated from the Astrid source by `tools/gen-appendices.sh`. The cross-chapter "See also" footers are generated by `tools/gen-see-also.pl`. Both read the polyrepo source tree, so run them from a checkout that has `core/`, `wit/`, and `capsules/` as siblings.

Dual-licensed under [MIT](LICENSE-MIT) and [Apache 2.0](LICENSE-APACHE).

Copyright (c) 2025-2026 Joshua J. Bouw and Unicity Labs.

aiSummary.oneLiner: The canonical reference manual and documentation for the Unicity Astrid OS, built with mdBook.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This repository houses the official, comprehensive documentation for the Unicity Astrid OS. It serves as the authoritative guide detailing the operating system's core architecture, including its kernel design, capsule-based process model, host Application Binary Interface (ABI), and underlying security framework. The book is generated using mdBook and includes automated tooling to extract accurate appendices—such as capability catalogs and error codes—directly from the polyrepo source tree, ensuring the documentation remains perfectly synchronized with the actual codebase.
keyFeatures: Canonical reference: The definitive source of truth for all architectural and design decisions in Astrid OS.
Automated appendices: Scripts automatically generate error codes and capability catalogs from the live OS source code.
Cross-referencing: Features automated 'See also' footers linking related concepts across different chapters.
mdBook integration: Built on the standard Rust documentation toolchain for a clean, readable web interface.
Polyrepo awareness: Tooling is designed to read across multiple sibling repositories to construct a unified guide.
